analysis:
Examined LaunchAgent.swift (base vs head) and the StartupPreloader.swift patch.

LaunchAgent.swift: the only functional change adds three env keys to inferencePassthroughEnvKeys (head lines 291-293): GlobalKVCacheBudget.idleCacheSweepEnvironmentKey, EngineV2Factory.segmentRetentionEnvironmentKey and EngineV2Factory.segmentHostZerosEnvironmentKey. It also removes nothing and adds no new keys at base lines 284-293 beyond these. These pass through only when the value is non-empty (lines 332-336), via the same allowlist mechanism as the other tuning knobs. They are operator-controlled rollback and tuning switches that persist in the user-owned launchd plist, which is the same trust level as the existing DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch. No secrets are forwarded, the worker opt-in remains restricted to exactly "1" (lines 338-341), and the stop/disable/RunAtLoad semantics are unchanged. The plist is written atomically as before.

The comments say 'retained, host-zeroed paged KV segments are on by default'. That is KV retention behavior defined in unseen files (EngineV2Factory, GlobalKVCacheBudget). It could touch T-028 (residual KV data in GPU/host memory) and T-041. This PR shows only the env passthrough, not the retention or zeroing implementation. Zeroing and retention of segments needs review in the unseen source, e.g. whether retained segments cross scope or cacheSalt boundaries. I cannot confirm those controls here.

StartupPreloader.swift: adds an optional reclaimBeforeSkip hook. It runs when free memory is below the requirement, then the requirement and free memory are re-sampled. It is purely a memory-admission availability behavior. The skip guard is unchanged, since the guard still requires freeGb >= requiredGb after reclaim. There is no auth, crypto or data exposure change visible. The hook implementation (what it reclaims, e.g. retained KV segments or the MLX buffer cache) is wired elsewhere and not supplied; if it frees without zeroing, it is relevant to T-028. The patch excerpt is truncated at the guard body but the remaining hunks were visible.

No findings. Deeper review is requested only for the unseen retention, host-zero and sweep implementations behind the new env keys.
